title: Railless Canvas: Contextual Surface & Compact Workspace Switch
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Reimagine the left navigation by removing rigid rail zones and introducing a railless canvas that surfaces contextual lanes, condensed workspace switching, and embedded dashboard rollouts. This ticket covers IA hypotheses, high-fidelity prototypes for the compact switcher, contextual entry points for per-route cost breakdowns, and a lightweight pattern for showing rollout state (canary/A-B/fallback) adjacent to routes. Goal: reduce clicks to key tasks (create rollout, view cost by model/route, switch workspace) from 3+ to 1-2 while keeping affordances for tenants with many projects.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates a railless canvas where primary navigation is a contextual column that appears on hover or via keyboard shortcut
Workspace switcher is accessible within 2 clicks and supports typed quick-jump with role-aware suggestions
Per-route rollout badge shows status and exposes canary controls in a single inline panel
Cost breakdown for the current route is surfaced as a compact pane with token-level and batch-level toggles
Design passes accessibility checks (keyboard only flow, contrast, screen reader labels) and has documented focus states
Engineering signals required DOM surface area and 95th percentile render latency is estimated and acceptable (ENG sign-off)
Usability test (5 sessions) shows >80% task success for switching workspaces and finding rollout state
decisions: Adopt railless canvas by default for teams with <40 projects; large tenants get an optional pinned compact rail
Workspace switcher will use fuzzy search with role-aware results and show last 5 recent contexts
Rollout state is represented by a compact badge + inline panel, not a separate page, to reduce context-switching
Cost insights are contextual to route and route-level filters persist across navigation until cleared
Keyboard shortcut (Cmd+K) will open quick jump focused on workspace/filter toggles when inside console
comments: 2025-11-12 Marisol Vega: Kickoff — IA sketching session completed. Merged two patterns: contextual lanes that slide over the canvas, and a compact, centered workspace modal for quick jumps. Next: generate hi-fi comps and a small usability script.
2025-11-15 Priya Patel (PM): Note — need to ensure that the rollout compact panel surfaces 'rollback' and 'metrics snapshot' actions for SRE workflows. Adding PM-4390 as dependency for metrics API.

2025-11-18 Avery Chen (Design): Prototype v1 pushed to Figma. Focus on hover-triggered lane and accessible keyboard variant. Early engineering feedback requested on probable DOM nodes and CSS animation cost.
2025-11-19 Rajiv Menon (ENG lead): Quick review — animation is OK but recommend reducing repaint cost by using transform + opacity. ENG-5783 opened to benchmark render path on our runtime.

2025-11-21 Usability findings: 5 participants. Positive for quick-switch but confusion around hover lane persistence. Recommendation: add a 'pin' affordance and explicit keyboard route to toggle lanes.

2025-11-24 Design critique (Cross-functional): PM prefers persistent small icons for commonly used routes; Design prefers minimalism. Agreed on hybrid: small icon dock when pinned and full contextual lane on demand.
2025-11-26 Accessibility pass: Keyboard flows added. Screen reader labels for rollout badges reviewed. One issue: cost pane table needs row-level aria labels — assigned to DES-23102 follow-up.
2025-11-27 GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/4123 — adds initial CSS and keyboard handling for railless lane. Requesting design review and engineering acceptance tests.

2025-11-29 Avery Chen: Updated comps v2 with pinned icon dock and micro-animations. Ready for In Review. Please add ENG sign-off on perf estimates. Scheduling design walkthrough with Eng on 2025-12-02.
